name: Noroware Kyoushitsu ~Kounai Itsudemo Dokodemo Yaranakucha?!~
original_name: ノロワレ教室 ～校内いつでもどこでも姦らなくちゃ？！～
source:
One day in a classroom, when students were having their belongings inspected many erotic objects were found in their bags, and suddenly an erotic video started playing on the class TV. There are suspicions about whether this is the work of a god, spirit, or monster that teaches the goodness of eroticism to students. The class president, Minami, is tasked with organizing the erotic objects and is interrupted by a classmate, Anri, who shows interest in the objects. Minami eventually collapses from exhaustion.
The next day, when she confronted some boys about their strange behavior, it turned out that they all had a video of Manami masturbating with an erotic toy from the day before. In the video, Manami smiles lasciviously and says, "P-Please tell me how many times you came using this video tomorrow..." Manami denies any involvement and claims that she has nothing to do with the video.
Anri starts deleting a video from a boy's phone when another boy refuses and escapes, only to be swallowed up by darkness. The classroom panics and an erotic video appears on the TV, causing the teacher, Hinano, to remember a similar incident from her school days. She believes the class is cursed and that they must engage in sexual activities every day. Those who try to run away will be swallowed by darkness and confined in a space of humiliation. The boys seem to enjoy the situation, while Manami's cries are in vain as the debauched school life begins.
translation:
有一天，在一间教室里，学生们在检查自己的物品时，在他们的包里发现了许多色情物品，突然，班级电视上开始播放色情视频。有人怀疑这是否是神灵或怪物的杰作，向学生传授色情的美好之处。班长南的任务是整理色情物品，但被对这些物品表现出兴趣的同学安里打断了。南最终因精疲力竭而倒下。
第二天，当她质问一些男孩的奇怪行为时，发现他们都有一段真奈美前一天用色情玩具自慰的视频。视频中，Manami淫荡地笑着说：“请、请告诉我你明天用这个视频来了多少次……”Manami否认有任何参与，并声称她与该视频无关。
当另一个男孩拒绝并逃跑时，杏里开始从一个男孩的手机中删除一段视频，结果却被黑暗吞没。教室里一片恐慌，电视上出现了色情视频，让日野老师想起了学生时代的类似事件。她认为班级受到了诅咒，他们必须每天进行性活动。那些试图逃跑的人将会被黑暗吞噬，并被禁锢在羞辱的空间里。男孩们似乎很享受这种情况，而随着放荡的学校生活的开始，真奈美的哭泣是徒劳的。
